bm_css:
<style>
.regolo-bm,
.regolo-bm * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  font-family: "Space Grotesk", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
}

.regolo-bm {
  width: 100% !important;
  max-width: 100% !important;
  margin: 3rem 0 !important;
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 52px 44px !important;
  padding-inline: 44px !important;
  background-color: #000000 !important;
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;base64,") !important;
  background-size: cover !important;
  background-position: center center !important;
  background-repeat: no-repeat !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.5);
  box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 0 35px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.22);
  color: #ffffff;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.regolo-bm__card {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.regolo-bm__head {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.regolo-bm__badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 12.5px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.4);
  background: rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.12);
  color: #58e388;
}

.regolo-bm__dot {
  width: 7px;
  height: 7px;
  background-color: #05df72;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 8px #05df72;
  display: inline-block;
}

.regolo-bm__title {
  margin: 0 0 14px 0 !important;
  font-size: clamp(26px, 3.6vw, 36px) !important;
  line-height: 1.16 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  text-align: center;
}

.regolo-bm__desc {
  margin: 0 auto 28px auto !important;
  font-size: 17.5px !important;
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
  color: #cbd5e1 !important;
  max-width: 820px;
  text-align: center;
}

.regolo-bm__legend {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 26px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.regolo-bm__swatch {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin-right: 8px;
  vertical-align: -2px;
}

.regolo-bm__swatch--clef { background: #05df72; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(5, 223, 114, 0.6); }
.regolo-bm__swatch--qwen { background: #64748b; }

.regolo-bm__metrics {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
}

.regolo-bm__metric {
  padding: 22px 24px !important;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.82);
  border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.22);
}

.regolo-bm__label {
  margin-bottom: 16px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #ffffff;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.regolo-bm__row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 118px 1fr 96px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  font-size: 15px;
}

.regolo-bm__row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

.regolo-bm__name { color: #cbd5e1; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

.regolo-bm__track {
  display: block;
  height: 18px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.14);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.regolo-bm__bar {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  min-width: 6px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
}

.regolo-bm__bar--clef { background: #05df72; box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(5, 223, 114, 0.55); }
.regolo-bm__bar--qwen { background: #64748b; }

.regolo-bm__value {
  text-align: right;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 16px;
  color: #ffffff;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.regolo-bm__stats {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.regolo-bm__stat {
  padding: 22px 18px !important;
  border-radius: 14px;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(5, 223, 114, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(5, 223, 114, 0.35);
}

.regolo-bm__stat strong {
  display: block;
  font-size: 38px;
  line-height: 1.1;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  color: #05df72;
  text-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(5, 223, 114, 0.45);
}

.regolo-bm__stat span {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 8px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #cbd5e1;
}

.regolo-bm__footnote {
  margin: 22px 0 0 0 !important;
  font-size: 13px !important;
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
  color: #94a3b8 !important;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 780px) {
  .regolo-bm { padding: 32px 20px !important; padding-inline: 20px !important; }
  .regolo-bm__metrics { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .regolo-bm__stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .regolo-bm__row { grid-template-columns: 102px 1fr 86px; font-size: 13.5px; }
}
</style>
tbl_map_css:
<style>
.regolo-tbl-wrap,.regolo-tbl-wrap *,.regolo-map,.regolo-map *{
  box-sizing:border-box;
  font-family:"Space Grotesk",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;
}
.regolo-tbl-wrap{
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  margin:2.5rem 0!important;
  padding:32px 30px!important;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:#050807;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,.45);
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 0 30px rgba(22,163,74,.16);
  color:#ffffff;
  overflow-x:auto;
}
.regolo-tbl__head{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:12px;
  margin-bottom:20px;
}
.regolo-tbl__title{
  margin:0!important;
  font-size:22px!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  color:#ffffff!important;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.regolo-tbl__sub{
  margin:4px 0 0 0!important;
  font-size:14.5px!important;
  color:#94a3b8!important;
}
.regolo-tbl{
  width:100%;
  border-collapse:separate;
  border-spacing:0;
  min-width:680px;
  font-size:13.5px;
}
.regolo-tbl th,.regolo-tbl td{
  padding:12px 12px;
  text-align:left;
  vertical-align:middle;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.14);
}
.regolo-tbl thead th{
  background:rgba(20,28,24,.95);
  color:#ffffff;
  font-size:15px;
  font-weight:700;
  padding-top:16px;
  padding-bottom:16px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);
  border-bottom:1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,.4);
}
.regolo-tbl thead th:first-child{
  border-top-left-radius:12px;
  border-left:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);
  color:#94a3b8;
  font-size:12.5px;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
}
.regolo-tbl thead th:last-child{
  border-top-right-radius:12px;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);
}
.regolo-tbl thead th small{
  display:block;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:500;
  color:#94a3b8;
  margin-top:3px;
}
.regolo-tbl tbody tr:nth-child(even) td{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);
}
.regolo-tbl tbody tr:hover td{
  background:rgba(5,223,114,.05);
}
.regolo-tbl tbody td:first-child{
  font-weight:600;
  color:#e2e8f0;
  width:165px;
}
.regolo-tbl tbody td:first-child span{
  display:block;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:400;
  color:#94a3b8;
  margin-top:2px;
}
.regolo-tbl tbody td{
  color:#cbd5e1;
}
.regolo-pill{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:5px;
  padding:3px 8px;
  border-radius:9999px;
  font-size:12px;
  font-weight:700;
  background:rgba(5,223,114,.14);
  border:1px solid rgba(5,223,114,.45);
  color:#58e388;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.regolo-pill--warn{
  background:rgba(245,158,11,.14);
  border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.45);
  color:#fbbf24;
}
.regolo-pill--muted{
  background:rgba(148,163,184,.12);
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.28);
  color:#cbd5e1;
  font-weight:600;
}
.regolo-cell-sub{
  display:block;
  font-size:12px;
  color:#94a3b8;
  margin-top:4px;
}
.regolo-map{
  width:100%!important;
  max-width:100%!important;
  margin:2.75rem 0!important;
  padding:38px 34px!important;
  border-radius:18px;
  background:#050807;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,.5);
  box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.9),0 0 35px rgba(22,163,74,.2);
  color:#ffffff;
}
.regolo-map__top{
  text-align:center;
  margin-bottom:28px;
}
.regolo-map__badge{
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:8px;
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:5px 14px;
  border-radius:9999px;
  border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.4);
  background:rgba(74,222,128,.12);
  color:#58e388;
  margin-bottom:12px;
}
.regolo-map__dot{
  width:7px;
  height:7px;
  border-radius:50%;
  background:#05df72;
  box-shadow:0 0 8px #05df72;
}
.regolo-map__title{
  margin:0 auto 8px auto!important;
  font-size:clamp(23px,3vw,30px)!important;
  line-height:1.2!important;
  font-weight:700!important;
  color:#ffffff!important;
}
.regolo-map__desc{
  margin:0 auto!important;
  font-size:15.5px!important;
  color:#cbd5e1!important;
  max-width:760px;
}
.regolo-map__cols-hdr{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:1.15fr 36px 1fr 36px 1.15fr;
  gap:8px;
  padding:0 14px 10px 14px;
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.07em;
  color:#58e388;

.regolo-map__lanes{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;

.regolo-map__lane{

  background:rgba(17,22,19,.92);
  border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.24);
}
.regolo-map__lane--hero{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,223,114,.09) 0%,rgba(17,22,19,.95) 50%,rgba(5,223,114,.07) 100%);

.regolo-map__box{

  border-radius:11px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.16);
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  justify-content:center;
}
.regolo-map__box--model{
  background:rgba(5,223,114,.10);
  border:1.5px solid rgba(5,223,114,.48);
  text-align:center;
}
.regolo-map__box--icp{
  background:rgba(20,28,24,.88);
  border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.3);
}
.regolo-map__kicker{
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:700;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  letter-spacing:.06em;
  color:#94a3b8;
  margin-bottom:5px;
}
.regolo-map__box--icp .regolo-map__kicker{
  color:#58e388;
}
.regolo-map__main{
  font-size:15.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  color:#ffffff;
  line-height:1.3;
  margin-bottom:6px;
}
.regolo-map__box--model .regolo-map__main{
  font-size:17px;
  color:#05df72;
}
.regolo-map__meta{
  font-size:13px;
  color:#cbd5e1;
  line-height:1.4;
}
.regolo-map__tags{
  display:flex;
  flex-wrap:wrap;
  justify-content:center;
  gap:6px;
  margin-top:8px;
}
.regolo-map__tag{
  font-size:11.5px;
  font-weight:700;
  padding:3px 8px;
  border-radius:6px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  border:1px solid rgba(74,222,128,.35);
  color:#e2e8f0;
}
.regolo-map__arrow{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  color:#05df72;
  font-size:22px;
  font-weight:700;
}
.regolo-map__foot{
  margin-top:18px;
  text-align:center;
  font-size:12.5px;
  color:#94a3b8;
}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .regolo-map__cols-hdr{display:none}
  .regolo-map__lane{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}
  .regolo-map__arrow{transform:rotate(90deg);height:22px}
}
</style>
